trigger: Walk the block mid-day (ambient barks; any order).

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Ninety-six in the shade. People grill everything in their freezers before it turns. A block party nobody wanted.

nodes.speaker: amb_bike_kids
nodes.text: Mister! Mister with the dog! Is it true the Chinese did it? Jaden says it was a nuke.

choices.text: It was the sun. Big solar storm.

nodes.speaker: amb_bike_kids
nodes.text: The SUN? That's so much worse. You can't fight the sun.

nodes.speaker: amb_bike_kids
nodes.text: Okay but if it WAS a nuke, can we see it?

nodes.speaker: amb_bike_kids
nodes.text: We're doing deliveries. Notes between houses. Five cents a note. Or a granola bar.

nodes.speaker: amb_deputy_lusk
nodes.text: Curfew's dusk on this street. Not official. Mine. Don't make me be official.
